input.rationale: Article 16 contains mutual indemnities, but Array's indemnity at 16.2 is limited to Array's own commercialization in the Array Territory, Array-sponsored Clinical Studies and breach of Article 15 — it contains no Third Party intellectual-property infringement indemnity (Section 11.4 instead leaves each Subject Party to defend Infringement Actions "at its own expense"), no express duty to defend, and no cover for Array's breach of Law, unauthorized disclosure of our Confidential Information or Array's gross negligence/willful misconduct. Absence of any Vendor IP indemnity is walk-away territory under this rule, so the fallback is not met. Ono's indemnity at 16.1 is also materially broader than the narrow Customer indemnity the playbook permits. The procedure at 16.3 already supplies notice, control of the defense and full cooperation, so we have made only the additions needed at the preferred level and narrowed 16.1; we can discuss retaining a reciprocal product-liability allocation if Array grants the IP indemnity.

proposal.summary: Add Array defense duty and IP/law/confidentiality/GN-WM indemnity heads; narrow Ono's indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Array's indemnity currently omits Third Party intellectual property infringement, breach of Law, unauthorized disclosure of our Confidential Information and Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and contains no express duty to defend, so we have added them. We have also narrowed Ono's indemnity to Ono-supplied materials and Ono's breach of Law, per our indemnification position.
